caption: The drawing contains a rectangular composition with a decorative border consisting of alternating diagonal stripes in pink and yellow tones. The main central area is separated into two horizontal bands filled with a repeating pattern. Each band depicts two men in red coats, black pants, and black hats riding cream-colored horses. The horses have round marks on their bodies with the letters "E" and "A", respectively. The riders have dark hair and beards. The background of the bands is filled with stylized leaves and flowers in green, yellow, and pink colors. Large pink circular flowers with yellow centers and white petal-like details are prominent in the design, placed between the riders and filling in the spaces. Smaller round pink flowers and leafy branches are also scattered throughout the bands. The background color of the main area is a light greenish-blue. The overall composition is symmetrical and tightly filled with botanical and figurative motifs.
title: Plate 43: Painted Chest Design: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
